review_method: Repository and archived evidence only; manual SQL/PLpgSQL trace, lexical statement/effect review, immutable source checks and exact local file hash verification.

conditions_common.target_binding: The project reference must be checked at actual connector dispatch. SQL checks database/role/PG17 and installed Production fingerprints, not an independently authenticated project ID.
conditions_common.on_failure: STOP; if the same transaction remains open, only its full ROLLBACK. No resubmission or new diagnostic transaction.

checks.detail: Both candidates pin Production context, expected baseline digest and the relevant immutable function definitions. A different package changing these bindings requires new bytes, new hashes and a separate Go.

Exactly one explicit READ ONLY transaction, transaction-local settings, metadata/preflight DO blocks, one bounded result SELECT and terminal ROLLBACK. No COMMIT, DDL, DML, SET ROLE, role/ACL change, sequence allocation, source action or owner mutation.

Views, foreign/partitioned/inherited tables and unexpected custom types are rejected through pg_catalog before project-table data reads. AT binds 13 complete table shapes/126 built-in columns. CHDE binds all read relation kinds, required columns and a whole-row safe built-in type set, with exact scheduler shapes and subsequent full protected catalog equality.

AT invokes no project function. CHDE invokes only the fully pinned STABLE catalog_status_v1 reader, whose exact body was checked against the authorized installation file; it reads system catalog metadata plus the five named cron.job rows and invokes no project helper.

No original source text, HTTP body/header/error text, signing key, lease_token, credential token_hash, raw native authority, personal actor ID or auth-session record is returned. Body/original bytes are processed inside SQL only to produce bounded hashes and byte counts. New arbitrary GUC/default/constraint/trigger text is hashed rather than emitted.

AT checks its exact unique three-source lists, joined recent-source cardinality<=9, duplicate stored HTTP response refusal, method head<=1 and BG1 proof join<=1 before output; it caps serialized output at131072 bytes. CHDE fixes Cycle12 and9dispatches,5derived claims and bounded linked results; any invalid output-bound flag suppresses the payload, and serialized output is capped at262144 bytes.

Method, AT source/watch, jobs, intake, archive/projection and owner metadata column names/types were compared with immutable repository DDL. Actual current shape is enforced by the candidate when separately authorized; no live current-shape PASS is claimed now.

Enqueue/job identities and retained claim generations0..4 exactly match chDeRefreshRequestIdentity/retainedChDeClaim: fixed SHA256 prefixes, newline order and32hex suffix; generation0 retains original operation/lease IDs.

Quotes, dollar blocks, parentheses, statement order, CTE joins, subquery result cardinality and PLpgSQL gates reviewed. Offline lexical segmentation found only BEGIN/SET/DO/WITH/ROLLBACK top-level verbs and no executable write/sequence/HTTP/Owner call. No PostgreSQL parser or database execution was performed.
Both final manifests and every file they bind were independently reread and hashed. SHA/byte comparisons are recorded below. The independent review is outside those self-hash-free manifest chains.
Each Go covers only its own one-time read. Neither read authorizes installation, Owner receipt, closure, restart, source qualification, renewal, customer publication or the other package.

resolved_findings.finding: Some table reads/counts preceded local-table/type admission, allowing unknown view/foreign/inherited shapes to be evaluated before STOP.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both authors moved catalog-only relation/type admission before project data and rejected inheritance/partitions. Final reviewed hashes below supersede those candidates.

resolved_findings.finding: AT returned raw proconfig and SQL default/constraint/trigger expressions while their contents were being diagnosed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only SHA256/byte metadata for those strings is emitted; no arbitrary configuration or expression value is exported.

resolved_findings.finding: Declared maximum9 recent-source rows relied on constraints whose current form was being diagnosed.
resolved_findings.resolution: A LIMIT10 sentinel, exact source whitelist and duplicate batch/source test stop before payload; duplicate retained HTTP response also stops.

resolved_findings.finding: Declared method/BG1 maximum1 and exact source lists required explicit result gates independent of metadata under review.
resolved_findings.resolution: Method and identical BG1 join LIMIT2 sentinels stop on excess; both three-row source lists require exactly the three distinct expected IDs.

resolved_findings.finding: The ninth intake sentinel could be emitted in a payload whose read_bounds_ok flag was false, despite maximum8 permitted intake metadata rows.
resolved_findings.resolution: The final SELECT now returns only a compact STOP result before emitting payload when read_bounds_ok or mandatory function metadata is not true.

at_read_specific.semantics: Only stored metadata is observed. The fresh_complete field is a stored proof/timestamp correlation; this candidate deliberately does not invoke a full live guard. Missing/expired/revoked/uncorrelated records remain unavailable and cannot approve activation.

chde_read_specific.caller_result_contract_required: 02-RESULT-CONTRACT.json rejects unknown/missing/extra root keys and false/missing required correlations; successful SQL alone is insufficient.
chde_read_specific.source_archive_semantics: Linked original bodies are not exported; their stored bytes are hashed inside SQL and compared with immutable raw_digest. This is archival identity proof, not new source verification.
chde_read_specific.restart_policy: Even a future closure/Owner receipt must leave dispatch closed. A distinct one-cycle restart Go is required before any new natural HTTP/source cycle.

pinned_catalog_reader.special_metadata_read: Five named cron.job rows, LIMIT6; command only hashed; catalog equality sees the metadata but the response does not export the full catalog.
pinned_catalog_reader.clarification: Names of allocator functions occur as quoted regprocedure lookup strings; they are not invoked.

limitations: This is a static review of review packages, not a native SQL parse, a Dev rehearsal, a Production read or a statement about current live state.
A later read needs its exact separate Owner Go and unchanged final bytes; prior completed one-time authorizations are not reused.
The SQL project context is an environment fingerprint; project identity must be checked in the connector call itself.
Body hashing necessarily processes retained bytes inside SQL. The no-body/no-header boundary here means no raw-body/header/token export and no external source request.
A read can discover that a required relation/privilege/custody/correlation differs. That must STOP; no runtime repair, role change or exploratory fallback is implied.
Historical CHDE503 trigger remains unproven; a current identity read does not reconstruct missing historical execution traces.
No static or previous Dev success transfers approval to Production writes. AT remains unavailable; CHDE closure/restart remains separately gated.

execution_limits.failure_control: Stop; ensure rollback of the same read-only transaction if its connection remains available. Do not open a new transaction or resubmit the file.

lexical_review_base.parser_level: offline lexical segmentation and manual review only; no PostgreSQL parse or execution

at.change: Only final source-identity and method/BG1 cardinality gates added after the lexical base; each added SELECT/RAISE gate was manually reread and final bytes rebound.

chde.change: Final CASE checks read_bounds_ok and required_function_metadata_present with IS DISTINCT FROM true before any payload/size return. False/missing flags produce only a compact STOP envelope; no ninth intake row can be exported.
